name: NaN is rejected
rationale: RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3: NaN is not a JSON value. A conformant RFC 8785 implementation MUST reject it rather than coercing to null.

name: positive Infinity is rejected
rationale: RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3: Infinity is not a JSON value. A conformant RFC 8785 implementation MUST reject it rather than coercing to null.

name: negative Infinity is rejected
rationale: RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3: Negative Infinity is not a JSON value. A conformant RFC 8785 implementation MUST reject it rather than coercing to null.

name: fractional double is rejected (ADR_019 number rule)
rationale: ADR_019 decision 2: a number is legal iff it is a finite INTEGER. 3.14 is a valid JSON value but the SynOI number rule forbids non-integer numbers before hashing (money is integer minor units). A conformant impl MUST reject it, not canonicalize it. This replaces the pre-ADR_019 'fractional double' happy-path vector.

name: small float in exponential notation is rejected (ADR_019 number rule)
rationale: ADR_019 decision 2: non-integer numbers are forbidden regardless of notation. 1e-10 is a finite non-integer and MUST be rejected. This replaces the pre-ADR_019 'small float uses exponential notation' happy-path vector in canonicalize-edge.json.
